text: わたしの　ポリシーはね…　みず　タイプ　ポケモンで　せめて　せめて　…せめまくる　ことよ！

structure.jp: わたしの　ポリシーはね…
みず　タイプ　ポケモンで
せめて　せめて　…せめまくる　ことよ！
structure.en: is to attack, attack... and keep on attacking!

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto an action word means doing it over and over without holding back. せめまくる = 'attack like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after an action word turns the action into a thing, so it can be what the policy is. せめまくる　こと = 'attacking like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で shows what is used to do something. みず　タイプ　ポケモンで = 'using Water-type Pokémon'.
